description: Off the ship, not on the plane yet: a Florida cruise debark day. Off the ship in the morning (default 8 AM), flying out later: up to 3 of our own picks near the port in order with drive times, trimmed so the person leaves the last one in time to be at the airport 2 hours before a flight in the U.S. (3 for international, the TSA's general advice), plus the leave-for-the-airport time. Ports: PortMiami, Port Everglades, Port Canaveral, Port Tampa Bay, JAXPORT, Key West; the airport defaults to the usual one for the port (MIA, FLL, MCO, TPA, JAX, EYW). bags=true (all the luggage, no car) keeps it to 2 stops. Drive times are estimates; the person decides.

airport.description: Florida airport code, e.g. MCO (default: the usual one for the port)

bags.description: true when they carry all their bags and have no car (2 stops at most)

flight.description: The flight's departure time, e.g. 4 PM or 16:00

international.description: true for a flight abroad (3 hours early instead of 2)

lang.description: Language for the descriptions and category names: en (default), es, pt

mood.description: beach (default), old (Old Florida), rain, wild, weird, road

off_ship.description: When they are off the ship, e.g. 8 AM (default 8:00 AM)

name: debark_day
title: Cruise debark day
